card.name: Words just before urinary catheter
card.fires_on: Small linking words or articles right before the word catheter in bladder instillation or urinary catheter instructions, such as a, by, via, and commas.

modes.label: Link before catheter
modes.description: A preposition or article such as by, via or a that comes right before catheter after into the bladder.

modes.label: Article or comma in insertion steps
modes.description: A or a comma in steps about inserting a urinary or urethral catheter.
modes.example: Insert<< a>> urethral catheter into the patient
